name: Revelation
lede: The sixty-sixth and last book of the Bible, in full: John on Patmos and the Son of man among the seven golden candlesticks, the letters to the seven churches, the throne in heaven and the Lamb that was slain, the seals, the trumpets and the bowls, the woman and the beasts, the fall of Babylon, the Word of God on the white horse, the thousand years, and the new heaven and the new earth and the holy city, new Jerusalem, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: I Am the Alpha and the Omega
books.blurb: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, sent by his angel unto his servant John; grace and peace to the seven churches that are in Asia; behold, he cometh with the clouds; I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith the Lord God; John in the isle that is called Patmos, in the Spirit on the Lord's day; seven golden candlesticks and one like unto a son of man in the midst of them — fear not; I am the first and the last; then the letters to the angels of the churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea: he that hath an ear, let him hear; behold, I stand at the door and knock.

books.name: Worthy Is the Lamb
books.blurb: A door opened in heaven, and a throne set in heaven with a rainbow round about it like an emerald; four and twenty elders crowned with gold, seven lamps of fire, a sea of glass, four living creatures full of eyes — holy, holy, holy; a book close sealed with seven seals, and none worthy to open it; the Lamb standing, as though it had been slain — worthy is the Lamb; the white, the red, the black and the pale horse; the souls underneath the altar; the sun black as sackcloth; four angels holding the four winds, the hundred and forty and four thousand sealed, and a great multitude in white robes with palms in their hands.

books.name: Silence in Heaven
books.blurb: The seventh seal, and silence in heaven about the space of half an hour; seven angels with seven trumpets, and the golden censer at the altar; hail and fire, a great mountain burning cast into the sea, the star called Wormwood, the third part of the sun smitten; an eagle crying woe; the pit of the abyss, its smoke and its locusts; the four angels loosed at the great river Euphrates; a strong angel with one foot upon the sea and one upon the earth, and the little book sweet as honey; the two witnesses, the two olive trees and the two candlesticks; the kingdom of the world is become the kingdom of our Lord, and the ark of his covenant seen in his temple.

books.name: A Great Sign in Heaven
books.blurb: A woman arrayed with the sun, the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars; another sign, a great red dragon; her child caught up unto God and unto his throne, and her flight into the wilderness; war in heaven, Michael and his angels, and the old serpent cast down; a beast coming up out of the sea, with ten horns and seven heads, and another out of the earth with two horns like a lamb; the mark, and the number of the beast; the Lamb standing on the mount Zion with the hundred and forty and four thousand; three angels flying in mid heaven — fallen, fallen is Babylon the great; one like unto a son of man on a white cloud, the harvest and the vintage of the earth.

books.name: Fallen Is Babylon the Great
books.blurb: Seven angels having the seven last plagues, and a sea of glass mingled with fire — the song of Moses and the song of the Lamb; the seven golden bowls poured out upon the earth, the sea, the rivers, the sun, the throne of the beast and the great river Euphrates; behold, I come as a thief; Har-Magedon; it is done; the great harlot that sitteth upon many waters, the scarlet-coloured beast, the seven mountains and the ten kings — and the Lamb shall overcome them; then fallen, fallen is Babylon the great: come forth, my people; the kings, the merchants and the shipmasters standing afar off; a great millstone cast into the sea.
